card.window_open_hint: Consider turning off the air conditioner.
card.mold_hint: Risk of mould – dehumidify or ventilate

editor.name: Name
editor.temperature_sensor: Current temperature: sensor or thermostat (empty = air conditioner)
editor.use_sensor_for_current: Use as current temperature (off = tile only)
editor.dropdown_threshold: Dropdown from this many options (0 = always chips)
editor.timer_switch: Arming switch (input_boolean) – row appears below the fan
editor.auto_heating_sensors: Add valves & batteries from device/area automatically

light_editor.name: Name
light_editor.auto_shortcuts: Use switches of the device (e.g. gradient)

light_group_editor.title: Title
light_group_editor.hint: Each light automatically shows only what it supports: brightness, white tone, color, effects – on/off lights just the switch.
light_group_editor.default_presets: Presets bright / warm / cozy for all

cover_editor.name: Name
cover_editor.weather_entity: Weather in the window (clouds, rain, snow)

cover_group_editor.title: Title
cover_group_editor.hint: Each cover is shown as a tile side by side – with a draggable window and exactly the buttons it supports.

switch_time_editor.name: Name
switch_time_editor.hint: What happens at that time is handled by an automation (e.g. a "time" trigger using the input_datetime, condition: switch on).

media_editor.name: Name
media_editor.hint: Volume goes to the soundbar/AV receiver automatically, the d-pad to the device of the running activity – changeable in the Harmony section.

room.title: Room
room.warn_hint: close the window or switch off

room_editor.title: Title
room_editor.hint_tile: Tile: tap opens the page, long press toggles the light. Small icons show light on, window open, A/C/TV on and waste pickups.

status_editor.title: Title
status_editor.hint: Areas: one battery sensor per device (Battery Notes preferred, incl. battery type like "2× AA").

vacuum_editor.name: Name
vacuum_editor.hint: Rooms and room borders come from the map image (e.g. Roborock Custom Map). Room cleaning via vacuum.send_command "app_segment_clean".

presence_editor.hint: Phone battery and charging state are found automatically via the person's device tracker (Companion app). Doorbell and battery warning come automatically from the lock device.

alert.hidden_hint: Without an active alert the card is hidden on the dashboard.

alert_editor.hint: The card only appears while an alert is active. More alerts (e.g. vacuum error, alarm, battery) via YAML under "alerts":

energy.switch_on: Switch on – long press turns off
energy.switch_off: Switch off – long press turns on
energy.no_stats: No long-term statistics for these sensors

energy_editor.title: Title
energy_editor.hint: Same config as power-flow-card-plus (entities: solar/battery/grid/home/individual). Names, icons, colors and switches of consumers via YAML.

irrigation.title: Water pump
irrigation.pump_needed: Turn on the pump to open valves
irrigation.smart_locked: In smart mode the duration is calculated
irrigation.plan: Plan for the next smart run

irrigation_editor.title: Title
irrigation_editor.hint: Timer, duration, flow, volume and custom start/stop scripts per zone via YAML (code editor). Flow and battery sensors are found automatically when named like the valve (e.g. sensor.valve_lawn_flow).

pool.title: Pool
pool.ph_high: pH too high – {g} g pH minus
pool.ph_low: pH too low – {g} g pH plus
pool.cl_low: Chlorine low – check tab or {g} g granules
pool.auto_off_hint: turns off when the pump is unreachable

pool_editor.title: Title
pool_editor.hint: Backwash/rinse, solar, ranges and care via YAML (code editor).

camera_editor.name: Name
camera_editor.title: Title
camera_editor.hint: Detection, battery, Wi-Fi, light, siren, presets and PTZ are found automatically via the camera's device – overridable via YAML (e.g. light: light.x).

select_editor.title: Title
select_editor.hint: Icons and colors are guessed from the option names. Per option overridable, hideable and with confirmation – via YAML:

mower.title: Lawn mower
mower.live_hint: Live position requested while the card is visible
mower.areas_not_ready: Starting works when the mower is docked or paused
mower.areas_multi_hint: Several areas: may still be experimental in the integration
mower.areas_multi_blocked: Several areas at once are not enabled yet (integration option “experimental drive commands”). Please select one area.
mower.areas_start_hint: “Mow” now starts only the selected areas

mower_editor.name: Name
mower_editor.hint: Battery, error, progress, areas, blades, Wi-Fi, stop button, mowing mode, rain delay and switches are detected via the device and can be overridden in YAML (e.g. blade: sensor.xyz).

starlink.title: Starlink
starlink.alert_obstructed: View of the sky is obstructed

starlink_editor.name: Name
starlink_editor.hint: Ping, throughput, warnings, stow, reboot and speed test values are detected automatically via the devices and can be overridden in YAML (e.g. ping: sensor.xyz, speedtest_upload: sensor.xyz).

llm.title: AI timeline
llm.empty: No events in the last {n} days

llm_editor.name: Name
llm_editor.hint: Events, images and cameras come from the llmvision.get_events action; without it the card reads the calendar (then without images). The category (person, vehicle, animal …) is taken from the label or the title.

home_battery.title: Home battery
home_battery.cloud_offline: Cloud unreachable – values may be stale

home_battery_editor.name: Name
home_battery_editor.hint: Power values, status, capacity, PV strings, yield and savings are detected via the device and its parent system (e.g. Anker Solix) and can be overridden in YAML (solar:, home:, battery_power:, strings: […]).

system_editor.name: Name
system_editor.hint: CPU/RAM/disk, all update.* entities and the backup integration sensors are detected automatically.

agenda.title: Agenda & waste
agenda.no_events: No events in the next {n} days

agenda_editor.name: Name
agenda_editor.waste_in_agenda: Show waste in the event list too
agenda_editor.hint: Waste types (general, bio, paper, recycling, glass …) are recognised by name and colour coded.

recipe.title: Meal plan
recipe.search_for_slot: Search a recipe for the empty slot …
recipe.added: {n} ingredients added to the shopping list

recipe_editor.name: Name
recipe_editor.hint: The Mealie integration is detected automatically. Without the Mealie URL no recipe images are loaded.

scene_editor.name: Name
scene_editor.hint: Pick Hue rooms and zones; their lights show up automatically (group on top, single lights expandable). Custom rooms: YAML "groups" (name, icon, match or scenes, lights).

sleep_editor.name: Name
sleep_editor.hint: Per person: name, sleep (input_boolean), timers (switch + time), climate, lights, media, alarm. "Good night" turns lights and media off and sleep mode on.

climate_rooms_editor.name: Name
climate_rooms_editor.hint: Per room: name, icon, temperature, humidity, heating (climate), ac (climate), window, navigation_path. Temperature and humidity fall back to the heating.

energy_week.title: Energy week
energy_week.no_entities: No energy meters found – add them to the card or the energy settings

energy_week_editor.name: Name
energy_week_editor.hint: Compared up to the same weekday of the previous week. Tap a day for its breakdown.

parcel.title: Parcels
parcel.not_found_hint: 17TRACK has no data yet – it usually appears once the carrier picks up the parcel.
parcel.empty_hint: No parcels – add a tracking number with "+ Parcel"

parcel_editor.name: Name
parcel_editor.hint: Data comes from the 17TRACK integration (found automatically).

router.title: Router
router.not_found: No router found – pick one of the router's entities in the editor
router.qr_hint: Scan with your phone camera to join the guest Wi-Fi

router_editor.name: Name
router_editor.hint: Everything else (throughput, line, CPU/RAM, Wi-Fi, restart, update, devices) is detected from the device – e.g. FRITZ!Box, TP-Link, ASUS, UniFi.

lock_editor.name: Name
lock_editor.hint: Doorbell, Ring to Open, battery and door sensor are found via the device. The history shows who unlocked (person or automation).

temperature_editor.title: Title
temperature_editor.hint: Device temperatures (e.g. Shelly) warn from 60 °C and alarm from 80 °C. Custom limits per sensor via YAML:

network.title: Network
network.map_timeout: No answer from Zigbee2MQTT – is the bridge running?
network.map_admin: The network map needs an administrator user (MQTT)

network_editor.title: Title
network_editor.hint: Signal (Zigbee LQI or Wi-Fi dBm), battery, firmware updates and warnings are detected via the devices. Problems are listed first.

plug_editor.title: Title
plug_editor.hint: Power, energy, temperature and warnings (overpower, overheating) are found via the device. “Not running” warning (e.g. fridge) via YAML:

grill.title: Meat thermometer
grill.take_out: Take it out now and let it rest!

grill_editor.title: Title
grill_editor.entities: Probes (one temperature each, empty = all Meater)
grill_editor.hint: Internal, ambient, target and peak temperature, cook state, cook name and remaining time are found per probe via the device.
